resources.string: Draws MangaLens\'s English at full strength

Draws MangaLens\'s English over the page at full strength. Without it, Android keeps the lettering slightly see-through and the original text shows faintly underneath. This service only draws: it can\'t read your screen, see what you type, or act for you.
Scrolls the page for you when you start auto-scroll

Lets MangaLens scroll the page for you in any app. It drags the page only while you have auto-scroll running, and stops when you touch the screen. This switch can do nothing else: it can\'t read what\'s on the screen, see what you type, or tap anything. (The slow-down for big balloons uses the screen capture you already allow MangaLens.)
